work-productivity-ontology-typed-workflow-helper v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Provides structured, ontology-based workflow support for productivity and reliability tasks.
- Focuses on practical help with bug fixing, reliability, safety, and creation of adjacent skills.
- Responds to validated and broad user demand (12 signals across 3 source families).
- Produces checklists, plans, and artifacts tailored to user needs, emphasizing local-friendly solutions.
- Includes built-in validation and verification steps for outputs.
